before.requirement: Reach supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.
before.reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT, while the harness calls png_read_end after png_start_read_image. The intervening initialization and end-reading behavior are not supplied.

after.requirement: Reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.
after.reason: The relevant decompression code remains, but the supplied packet does not establish the end-reading call path or the effect of repeated row initialization.

claims.reason: The old harness uses the same call sequence on both sides. Whether that sequence blocks the same late metadata behavior cannot be decided from the supplied functions.
missing_information: The complete before and after bodies of png_start_read_image and png_app_error, to determine the effect of the second initialization.
The complete before and after bodies of png_read_end and the compressed ancillary handlers, to establish a path to png_decompress_chunk.
The delegated configuration that determines whether compressed ancillary reading is enabled.
The row initialization and end-reading call path is incomplete.
The build recipe modifies scripts/pnglibconf.dfa, but its defaults and the delegated configuration are not supplied. This prevents complete coverage of the configured target.
